name: The Statuary Garden
description: A massive arboretum near Aradara Station lined with statues of Ghirapur's most famous inventors; the renegades hide in a statue there.

timeline.summary: Yahenni goes to the Statuary Garden and climbs a ladder up a Vedalken inventor's statue where they sense the hidden renegades.
timeline.quote: I walk casually toward the statue and start to climb a ladder around the back.

timeline.summary: Jace causes Yahenni a body ache on the ladder until Nissa and Chandra recognize them and let them into the hideout.
timeline.quote: "Yahenni!" Chandra yells while opening the hatch and pulling me through.

timeline.summary: Chandra introduces Yahenni to Jace, Liliana and Gideon; Chandra says they got her mother free.
timeline.quote: Yahenni, this man is Jace, this woman is Liliana, and the man in the corner is Gideon.

timeline.summary: Yahenni warns that the Consulate is on its way and offers their penthouse as a safe hideout; the group agrees.
Yahenni, descending the ladder, sees a Consulate cruiser speeding toward the statue and leaps onto its hood, draining the enforcer driver to death.
The enforcer's cruiser crashes into another statue; Yahenni's life is extended to twenty-two days.
timeline.quote: I now have twenty-two days left to live.

timeline.summary: Nissa has Gideon call back Chandra, who walked the wrong way, and directs the group to Yahenni's home and sends word to Ajani, Pia and Mrs. Pashiri.
timeline.quote: Tell Chandra Yahenni's home is that way, and have Jace inform Ajani, Pia, and Mrs. Pashiri of our new location

timeline.summary: Nissa comforts Yahenni with a current of land energy, telling them they are her friend; Yahenni resolves to do good with their remaining days.
timeline.quote: "Because you are my friend," she says delicately.

pages_say.description: A massive arboretum near Aradara Station lined with statues of Ghirapur's most famous inventors; the renegades hide in a statue there.
